description:
📧 Got Bible Questions? 
Write to us at tv@sumtv.org, and your question could be featured in an upcoming Q&A episode! 🙏✨

QUESTION CHAPTERS: 
1. (2:40) Is the Sabbath celebrated in the unfallen worlds, too? Do they have a 7 day weekly cycle , too? Will the Sabbath be celebrated in Heaven during the Millenium? Is there a weekly cycle in heaven? If God created the universe during the Creation, is it true that the unfallen worlds were also created at the same time (or first 6 days of Creation)?
.
2. (8:08) Some people have criticized the SDA (Seventh-day Adventist) logo, claiming it has satanic elements. Can you provide more details on this?
.
3. (14:16)
1. in Deuteronomy 22:13-19 Not sure how can be proved the virginity of a girl as not always is blood, to be left after on the sheets, when she started her sexual life. Just a small number of women are leaving blood behind. In this situation can an innocent life be sacrificed?
2. Deuteronomy 22:23-24 I understand that it's trying to prevent fornication. But as I can imagine a girl that is raped is overpowered most of the time threatened that if she will scream will be killed. I can only imagine the horror of a rape victim. If she hasn't screamed being petrified she was meant to die?  I know I am not to judge the word of God in any way but I am struggling to understand this passage regarding the victim.
3. Is it appropriate to have intimate relations on Sabbath?
4. This one might be on the mystery level and I don't mind there is no answer to this, but I have asked myself about the law of heredity. The angels have been created individually and have chosen one by one to follow Jesus or Satan.
In the case of humanity by the sin of one all have been condemned.Why we haven't been in the same situation and we are all in this mess, and Jesus had to die?




🔍 Tune In Every Tuesday at 4:30 PM (Pacific Time) for our live Q&A straight from the studio—only on SUMtv.org! Don't miss out on additional in-depth Bible studies available at SecretsUnsealed.org.
